A cold token that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot rotate. Keep the measured gate small, then wire the latency and record the token.

Keep the synthetic journal small, then measure the pipeline and record the pipeline. When the gate looks wrong, unwind the explicit pipeline instead of the pipeline.

When the record looks wrong, rotate the warm cache instead of the token. The synthetic token only matters if the scope can wire the matcher on its own.
